content.class.hand.blurb: 看守请来一个帮手，去拧开那只老阀门，浇灭大厅里烧了三代人的大壁炉。
content.class.hand.kit.0.name: 帮手的剑
content.class.hand.kit.1.name: 帮手的靴子
content.class.hand.name: 看守的帮手
content.fx.the-fire.oc.turn-the-valve.4.narrate: 水轰隆隆灌下烟道。火嘶的一声灭了，炉膛的砖背向黑暗里转开：壁炉后面，一条密道一直钻进岩石里。
content.fx.trig.the-burning-hearth.0.narrate: 大壁炉烧着，自从看守的祖父点着它就没熄过。能把烟道灌满水的阀门在它右手边的墙上。
content.obj.the-fire.turn-the-valve.hint: 面朝壁炉的火，阀门就在它右手边的墙上。
content.obj.the-fire.turn-the-valve.title: 拉开壁炉旁的阀门
content.obj.the-way.enter-the-passage.hint: 壁炉的火灭了。穿过它，进到它后面的密道里。
content.obj.the-way.enter-the-passage.title: 穿过壁炉进入密道
content.quest.the-fire.goal: 走进看守的大厅，拧开大壁炉右手边的阀门，让水灌满烟道，浇灭炉火。
content.quest.the-way.goal: 穿过熄了火的壁炉，进到它后面的密道里。
content.world.outro: 壁炉冷了，敞着，看守的大厅安静了下来。
content.world.title: 暗道

source.class.hand.blurb: The keeper sent for a hand to turn the old valve and put out the great hearth of the hall, which has burned for three generations.
source.class.hand.kit.0.name: Hand's sword
source.class.hand.kit.1.name: Hand's boots
source.class.hand.name: Keeper's Hand
source.fx.the-fire.oc.turn-the-valve.4.narrate: Water roars down the flue. The fire hisses out, and the back of the firebox swings into the dark: behind the hearth, a passage runs on into the rock.
source.fx.trig.the-burning-hearth.0.narrate: The great hearth burns, as it has since the keeper's grandfather lit it. The valve that floods its flue is on the wall to its right.
source.obj.the-fire.turn-the-valve.hint: The valve is on the wall to the right of the great hearth, as you face its fire.
source.obj.the-fire.turn-the-valve.title: Pull the valve beside the hearth
source.obj.the-way.enter-the-passage.hint: The hearth's fire is out. Go through it into the passage behind it.
source.obj.the-way.enter-the-passage.title: Go through the hearth into the passage
source.quest.the-fire.goal: Come into the keeper's hall and turn the valve to the right of the great hearth, which floods the flue and puts out the fire.
source.quest.the-way.goal: Go through the cold hearth into the passage behind it.
source.world.outro: The hearth stands cold and open, and the keeper's hall is quiet.
source.world.title: A Hidden Way
